name: Day 6 — 週末小旅行 Weekend Getaway

qs.q: How do they get to the beach?
What do they eat at noon?
How does everyone feel going home?

gram.d: Tack 好不好 onto a suggestion to invite agreement: 我們去海邊，好不好？ — let's go to the beach, yeah? Softer than a command; 好嗎 works the same way.

readings.title: 買高鐵票 Buying HSR Tickets

qs.q: How many tickets does he buy?
Why does he want a window seat?
How does he pay?

gram.d: Tickets, paper, photos, tables, beds all count with 張: 兩張票, 一張照片. The clerk will always ask 幾張？ — how many?

readings.title: 自由座的秘密 The Free-Seating Trick

qs.q: What's the advantage of 自由座?
ch: Cheaper and hop on any train

qs.q: What happens in free seating when it's crowded?
His holiday advice?

gram.d: 只好 = have no choice but to: 沒位子，只好站著 — no seats, so standing it is. Resigned but accepting; pure Taiwanese commuter energy.

readings.title: 出差高雄 Business Trip South

qs.q: What was Mr. Wang's reply to the new quote?
What's the afternoon plan in Kaohsiung?
What does Mr. Wang offer in the evening?

gram.d: 順便 = while you're at it / on the way: 去拜訪客戶，順便看現場 — visit the client and check the site while there. Softens add-on requests too: 順便幫我買咖啡？

readings.title: 一日生活圈 The One-Day Living Circle

qs.q: What is the 一日生活圈?
ch: Western Taiwan reachable within a day

qs.q: What do operators say HSR convenience has driven?
What concern do experts raise?
ch: Youth leaving small towns — regional imbalance

gram.d: [event] 以來 = ever since [event]: 通車以來 since it opened. Formal-register sibling of 從…開始; pairs with ongoing trends (年年增加, 持續外流).

dict.zh: 你週末要去哪裡玩？
dict.py: Nǐ zhōumò yào qù nǎlǐ wán?
dict.en: Where are you going for fun this weekend?

dict.zh: 我們去海邊，好不好？
dict.py: Wǒmen qù hǎibiān, hǎo bù hǎo?
dict.en: Let's go to the beach, yeah?

dict.zh: 火車幾點開？
dict.py: Huǒchē jǐ diǎn kāi?
dict.en: What time does the train leave?

dict.zh: 我要買兩張票。
dict.py: Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng zhāng piào.
dict.en: I'd like two tickets.

dict.zh: 今天海邊人好多喔！
dict.py: Jīntiān hǎibiān rén hǎo duō o!
dict.en: The beach is packed today!

pass.zh: 喂，Eric！星期天我們要去海邊玩，你要不要一起來？早上九點在火車站見。記得帶水，還有帽子喔！

qs.q: When is the beach trip?
Where and when do they meet?

dict.zh: 下一班車十點半開。
dict.py: Xià yì bān chē shí diǎn bàn kāi.
dict.en: The next train leaves at 10:30.

dict.zh: 請問這個位子有人坐嗎？
dict.py: Qǐngwèn zhège wèizi yǒu rén zuò ma?
dict.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

dict.zh: 我們的位子在第七車。
dict.py: Wǒmen de wèizi zài dì qī chē.
dict.en: Our seats are in car seven.

dict.zh: 車上請不要講電話太大聲。
dict.py: Chē shàng qǐng búyào jiǎng diànhuà tài dàshēng.
dict.en: Please don't talk too loudly on the phone onboard.

dict.zh: 到台中要一個小時。
dict.py: Dào Táizhōng yào yíge xiǎoshí.
dict.en: It takes an hour to Taichung.

pass.zh: 各位旅客您好，往左營的列車就要開了，中間停台中、台南。請看您的票，對號座在第三到第九車，自由座在第十到第十二車，謝謝！

qs.q: Where is this train headed?
Which cars are free seating?

dict.zh: 來回票比較便宜。
dict.py: Láihuí piào bǐjiào piányí.
dict.en: Round-trip tickets are cheaper.

dict.zh: 這班沒有位子了，只有自由座。
dict.py: Zhè bān méiyǒu wèizi le, zhǐyǒu zìyóuzuò.
dict.en: This service is sold out — free seating only.

dict.zh: 時刻表可以用手機看。
dict.py: Shíkèbiǎo kěyǐ yòng shǒujī kàn.
dict.en: You can check the timetable on your phone.

dict.zh: 趕時間的話，先搭自由座吧。
dict.py: Gǎn shíjiān dehuà, xiān dā zìyóuzuò ba.
dict.en: If you're in a hurry, just take free seating.

dict.zh: 提前買票，通常有早鳥優惠。
dict.py: Tíqián mǎi piào, tōngcháng yǒu zǎoniǎo yōuhuì.
dict.en: Book early and there's usually an early-bird discount.

pass.zh: 旅客您好，高鐵早鳥票最早可以提前二十八天買，最多打六五折，但是數量有限，熱門班次很快就賣完。改時間的話，出發以前可以免費改一次喔。

qs.q: How early can early-bird tickets be bought?
What's the maximum discount?
What's the change policy?

dict.zh: 下星期三我們去高雄出差。
dict.py: Xià xīngqí sān wǒmen qù Gāoxióng chūchāi.
dict.en: Next Wednesday we're on a business trip to Kaohsiung.

dict.zh: 高鐵票我訂好了，八點的班次。
dict.py: Gāotiě piào wǒ dìng hǎo le, bā diǎn de bāncì.
dict.en: HSR tickets are booked — the 8 o'clock service.

dict.zh: 我們先拜訪王先生，下午看現場。
dict.py: Wǒmen xiān bàifǎng Wáng xiānshēng, xiàwǔ kàn xiànchǎng.
dict.en: We visit Mr. Wang first, then see the site in the afternoon.

dict.zh: 行程我寄給你，麻煩確認一下。
dict.py: Xíngchéng wǒ jì gěi nǐ, máfán quèrèn yíxià.
dict.en: I've sent you the itinerary — please confirm.

dict.zh: 回來以前，順便買一些名產。
dict.py: Huílái yǐqián, shùnbiàn mǎi yìxiē míngchǎn.
dict.en: Before heading back, grab some local specialties while we're there.

pass.zh: Eric，我是小陳。下星期三的行程：八點的高鐵，十點到王先生公司開會，中午他們請客，下午兩點看現場。晚上六點的班次回台北。行程表我已經寄到你的信箱，麻煩回覆確認，辛苦了！

qs.q: What time is the morning HSR?
Who's treating at lunch?
What should Eric do with the itinerary?

dict.zh: 高鐵今年旅客人數創新高。
dict.py: Gāotiě jīnnián lǚkè rénshù chuàng xīngāo.
dict.en: HSR passenger numbers hit a record this year.

dict.zh: 觀光產業持續成長。
dict.py: Guānguāng chǎnyè chíxù chéngzhǎng.
dict.en: The tourism industry keeps growing.

dict.zh: 專家指出，交通便利改變了生活方式。
dict.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, jiāotōng biànlì gǎibiàn le shēnghuó fāngshì.
dict.en: Experts note transport convenience has changed lifestyles.

dict.zh: 南北的時間縮短到九十分鐘。
dict.py: Nánběi de shíjiān suōduǎn dào jiǔshí fēnzhōng.
dict.en: North-south travel time has shrunk to ninety minutes.

dict.zh: 政府表示將增加假日班次。
dict.py: Zhèngfǔ biǎoshì jiāng zēngjiā jiàrì bāncì.
dict.en: The government stated it will add holiday services.

pass.zh: 交通新聞：高鐵公司表示，今年旅客人數預計創下新高，假日熱門班次常常一位難求。為了因應需求，將增加班次，也鼓勵旅客提前購票。學者指出，便利的交通帶動觀光，但區域發展的平衡仍需要政府努力。

qs.q: What problem occurs on holiday services?
What two responses are mentioned?
ch: More services and encouraging early booking

qs.q: What do scholars say still needs government effort?

scenarios.intro: At the ticket window: two tickets to Taichung, pick a time, pay, and find your platform. The full transaction, all yours.

them.zh: 你好，請問要去哪裡？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn yào qù nǎlǐ?
them.en: Hello — where to?

turns.task: Say you want two tickets to Taichung.

ans.zh: 你好，我要兩張去台中的票。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào liǎng zhāng qù Táizhōng de piào.
ans.en: Hi, two tickets to Taichung please.

them.zh: 好的，要幾點的？
them.py: Hǎo de, yào jǐ diǎn de?
them.en: Sure — what time?

turns.task: Ask what time the next train is.

ans.zh: 請問下一班是幾點？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn xià yì bān shì jǐ diǎn?
ans.en: What time is the next one?

them.zh: 下一班十點半，還有位子。
them.py: Xià yì bān shí diǎn bàn, háiyǒu wèizi.
them.en: Next one's 10:30, seats available.

turns.task: Great — take that one; you'll pay by card.

ans.zh: 好，就這班。我刷卡，謝謝。
ans.py: Hǎo, jiù zhè bān. Wǒ shuākǎ, xièxie.
ans.en: That one, please. Card, thanks.

them.zh: 兩張，一共七百塊。這是您的票。
them.py: Liǎng zhāng, yígòng qībǎi kuài. Zhè shì nín de piào.
them.en: Two tickets, 700 total. Here you go.

turns.task: Ask which platform the train leaves from (在幾月台).

ans.zh: 謝謝。請問在幾月台上車？
ans.py: Xièxie. Qǐngwèn zài jǐ yuètái shàngchē?
ans.en: Thanks. Which platform does it leave from?

them.zh: 第二月台，祝你們玩得開心！
them.py: Dì èr yuètái, zhù nǐmen wán de kāixīn!
them.en: Platform two — have a great trip!

turns.task: Thank them and say goodbye.

ans.zh: 謝謝你，再見！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ, zàijiàn!
ans.en: Thank you, goodbye!

scenarios.intro: You board the HSR and find someone in seat 12A — yours. Sort it out with maximum Taiwanese politeness on both sides.

them.zh: （坐在你的位子上滑手機）
them.py: (zuò zài nǐ de wèizi shàng huá shǒujī)
them.en: (sitting in your seat, scrolling their phone)

turns.task: Excuse me — say this seems to be your seat, 12A.

ans.zh: 不好意思，這個好像是我的位子，12A。
ans.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, zhège hǎoxiàng shì wǒ de wèizi, shí'èr A.
ans.en: Sorry — I think this is my seat, 12A.

them.zh: 蛤？不會吧，我看一下我的票……
them.py: Há? Bú huì ba, wǒ kàn yíxià wǒ de piào......
them.en: Huh? No way — let me check my ticket…

turns.task: No rush — tell them to take their time looking.

ans.zh: 沒關係，你慢慢看。
ans.py: Méi guānxi, nǐ mànmàn kàn.
ans.en: No rush — take your time.

them.zh: 啊，歹勢歹勢！我的是第十三車，坐錯車了！
them.py: A, pháinn-sè pháinn-sè! Wǒ de shì dì shísān chē, zuò cuò chē le!
them.en: Ah, so sorry! Mine's car 13 — wrong car!

turns.task: It's fine — tell them car 13 is just ahead (前面).

ans.zh: 沒事沒事！第十三車就在前面。
ans.py: Méi shì méi shì! Dì shísān chē jiù zài qiánmiàn.
ans.en: No worries! Car 13 is just ahead.

them.zh: 真的很不好意思，打擾你了！
them.py: Zhēnde hěn bù hǎo yìsi, dǎrǎo nǐ le!
them.en: Really sorry for the trouble!

turns.task: Reassure them warmly — it's nothing, safe travels (一路順風)!

ans.zh: 不會啦！一路順風！
ans.py: Bú huì la! Yílù shùnfēng!
ans.en: Not at all! Safe travels!

them.zh: 謝謝你，你人真好！掰掰！
them.py: Xièxie nǐ, nǐ rén zhēn hǎo! Bāibāi!
them.en: Thanks — you're so kind! Bye!

turns.task: Say bye — then settle into your window seat.

ans.zh: 掰掰！
ans.py: Bāibāi!
ans.en: Bye!

scenarios.who: 服務台人員 Service Counter Staff
scenarios.intro: Your meeting ran long and you'll miss your train. Change the ticket, weigh the free-seating option, and decide under mild time pressure.

them.zh: 您好，需要什麼服務？
them.py: Nín hǎo, xūyào shénme fúwù?
them.en: Hello — how can I help?

turns.task: Say you can't make your 3 o'clock train — you'd like to change to a later one.

ans.zh: 你好，我趕不上三點的車，想改晚一點的班次。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ gǎn bú shàng sān diǎn de chē, xiǎng gǎi wǎn yìdiǎn de bāncì.
ans.en: Hi — I can't make the 3 o'clock. I'd like to change to a later service.

them.zh: 好的。四點的對號座賣完了，五點的還有位子。
them.py: Hǎo de. Sì diǎn de duìhàozuò mài wán le, wǔ diǎn de háiyǒu wèizi.
them.en: Sure. The 4 o'clock reserved seats are sold out; 5 o'clock still has seats.

turns.task: Ask: can you take the 4 o'clock with free seating instead?

ans.zh: 請問四點的可以坐自由座嗎？
ans.py: Qǐngwèn sì diǎn de kěyǐ zuò zìyóuzuò ma?
ans.en: Could I take the 4 o'clock in free seating?

them.zh: 可以，但是假日人很多，可能要站著喔。
them.py: Kěyǐ, dànshì jiàrì rén hěn duō, kěnéng yào zhànzhe o.
them.en: You can — but it's a holiday, you might be standing.

turns.task: Decide: standing is fine, you're in a hurry — change it to the 4 o'clock free seating.

ans.zh: 沒關係，我趕時間，站著可以。麻煩幫我改四點的自由座。
ans.py: Méi guānxi, wǒ gǎn shíjiān, zhànzhe kěyǐ. Máfán bāng wǒ gǎi sì diǎn de zìyóuzuò.
ans.en: That's fine — I'm in a hurry, I can stand. Please change me to 4 o'clock free seating.

them.zh: 好的，出發前第一次改票免費。這是您的新票。
them.py: Hǎo de, chūfā qián dì yī cì gǎi piào miǎnfèi. Zhè shì nín de xīn piào.
them.en: Done — the first change before departure is free. Here's your new ticket.

turns.task: Great — confirm: free seating is cars 10 to 12, right?

ans.zh: 太好了。自由座是第十到十二車，對嗎？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le. Zìyóuzuò shì dì shí dào shí'èr chē, duì ma?
ans.en: Great. Free seating is cars 10 to 12, right?

them.zh: 對的，請提早到月台排隊。祝您旅途愉快！
them.py: Duì de, qǐng tízǎo dào yuètái páiduì. Zhù nín lǚtú yúkuài!
them.en: Correct — head to the platform early to queue. Have a good trip!

turns.task: Thank them for the help.

ans.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ de bāngmáng!
ans.en: Thanks for your help!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: The quote is accepted — now plan Wednesday's client visit south: trains, itinerary, and who confirms what. Business logistics, in Mandarin, like it's nothing.

them.zh: Eric，王先生說下星期三歡迎我們去高雄！
them.py: Eric, Wáng xiānshēng shuō xià xīngqí sān huānyíng wǒmen qù Gāoxióng!
them.en: Eric — Mr. Wang says we're welcome in Kaohsiung next Wednesday!

turns.task: Great news! Propose taking the 8 o'clock HSR service down.

ans.zh: 太好了！我們搭八點的高鐵班次下去吧。
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǒmen dā bā diǎn de gāotiě bāncì xiàqù ba.
ans.en: Excellent! Let's take the 8 o'clock HSR down.

them.zh: 好，票我來訂。行程你覺得怎麼安排？
them.py: Hǎo, piào wǒ lái dìng. Xíngchéng nǐ juéde zěnme ānpái?
them.en: I'll book the tickets. How should we arrange the itinerary?

turns.task: Propose: morning meeting first, site visit in the afternoon.

ans.zh: 早上先開會，下午再看現場，怎麼樣？
ans.py: Zǎoshang xiān kāihuì, xiàwǔ zài kàn xiànchǎng, zěnmeyàng?
ans.en: Meeting in the morning, site visit in the afternoon — how's that?

them.zh: 可以。對了，要帶新的報價單跟合約嗎？
them.py: Kěyǐ. Duìle, yào dài xīn de bàojiàdān gēn héyuē ma?
them.en: Works. Oh — should we bring the new quote and the contract?

turns.task: Yes — bring both; you'll email Mr. Wang today to confirm the itinerary.

ans.zh: 要，兩個都帶。我今天寄信跟王先生確認行程。
ans.py: Yào, liǎng ge dōu dài. Wǒ jīntiān jì xìn gēn Wáng xiānshēng quèrèn xíngchéng.
ans.en: Yes, bring both. I'll email Mr. Wang today to confirm the itinerary.

them.zh: 讚。聽說他們公司附近有很有名的鴨肉飯喔。
them.py: Zàn. Tīngshuō tāmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn yǒumíng de yāròu fàn o.
them.en: Nice. I hear there's famous duck rice near their office.

turns.task: Perfect — after the site visit, grab some while you're at it (順便).

ans.zh: 太好了，看完現場我們順便去吃！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, kàn wán xiànchǎng wǒmen shùnbiàn qù chī!
ans.en: Perfect — after the site we'll swing by for some!

them.zh: 哈哈，出差最重要的行程！那就這樣說定了。
them.py: Hāhā, chūchāi zuì zhòngyào de xíngchéng! Nà jiù zhèyàng shuōdìng le.
them.en: Haha, the most important agenda item! Settled, then.

turns.task: Settled — thank him for booking the tickets.

ans.zh: 說定了！票的事就麻煩你了，謝謝！
ans.py: Shuōdìng le! Piào de shì jiù máfán nǐ le, xièxie!
ans.en: Settled! Thanks for handling the tickets!

scenarios.intro: OPI drill of the day: argue how high-speed rail reshaped Taiwan — thesis, evidence, concession, and a policy view. Paragraphs, not sentences.

them.zh: 你常搭高鐵嗎？你覺得它改變了台灣什麼？
them.py: Nǐ cháng dā gāotiě ma? Nǐ juéde tā gǎibiàn le Táiwān shénme?
them.en: Do you ride the HSR often? What do you think it changed about Taiwan?

turns.task: Yes, often for work — argue it created the one-day living circle: north-south in ninety minutes.

ans.zh: 常搭，出差都靠它。我認為最大的改變是一日生活圈：南北只要九十分鐘。
ans.py: Cháng dā, chūchāi dōu kào tā. Wǒ rènwéi zuìdà de gǎibiàn shì yírì shēnghuóquān: nánběi zhǐyào jiǔshí fēnzhōng.
ans.en: All the time — every business trip. The biggest change is the one-day living circle: north to south in just ninety minutes.

them.zh: 具體來說，對商務有什麼影響？
them.py: Jùtǐ láishuō, duì shāngwù yǒu shénme yǐngxiǎng?
them.en: Concretely, how has it affected business?

turns.task: Two effects: same-day client visits became normal, and companies can serve the whole island from one office.

ans.zh: 第一，當天來回拜訪客戶變成常態；第二，一個辦公室就可以服務全台灣。
ans.py: Dì yī, dàngtiān láihuí bàifǎng kèhù biànchéng chángtài; dì èr, yíge bàngōngshì jiù kěyǐ fúwù quán Táiwān.
ans.en: First, same-day round-trip client visits became the norm; second, one office can now serve all of Taiwan.

them.zh: 不過也有人說，高鐵讓小地方的人才都跑去大城市了。
them.py: Búguò yě yǒu rén shuō, gāotiě ràng xiǎo dìfāng de réncái dōu pǎo qù dà chéngshì le.
them.en: But some say the HSR drained talent from small towns into big cities.

turns.task: Concede the point is real, then argue convenience isn't the root cause — jobs are; policy should bring industry south.

ans.zh: 這個現象確實存在，但是我覺得原因不是交通，而是工作機會。政策應該把產業帶到南部。
ans.py: Zhège xiànxiàng quèshí cúnzài, dànshì wǒ juéde yuányīn búshì jiāotōng, érshì gōngzuò jīhuì. Zhèngcè yīnggāi bǎ chǎnyè dài dào nánbù.
ans.en: The phenomenon is real, but the cause isn't transport — it's jobs. Policy should bring industry south.

turns.keys: 確實存在工作機會產業南部

them.zh: 如果讓你建議政府一件事，你會說什麼？
them.py: Rúguǒ ràng nǐ jiànyì zhèngfǔ yí jiàn shì, nǐ huì shuō shénme?
them.en: If you could advise the government on one thing, what would it be?

turns.task: Suggest investing in southern tech parks — your own industry included — so young people can stay home and still find good jobs.

ans.zh: 我會建議投資南部的科技園區，包括無人機這種產業，讓年輕人留在家鄉也找得到好工作。
ans.py: Wǒ huì jiànyì tóuzī nánbù de kējì yuánqū, bāokuò wúrénjī zhè zhǒng chǎnyè, ràng niánqīngrén liú zài jiāxiāng yě zhǎo de dào hǎo gōngzuò.
ans.en: Invest in southern tech parks — drones included — so young people can stay home and still find good jobs.

turns.keys: 投資南部科技園區留在家鄉

them.zh: 講得很有道理！謝謝你的分享。
them.py: Jiǎng de hěn yǒu dàolǐ! Xièxie nǐ de fēnxiǎng.
them.en: Very well argued! Thanks for sharing.

turns.task: Thank the host — say next time you'll report from Kaohsiung.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人！下次我從高雄連線跟你報導！
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén! Xiàcì wǒ cóng Gāoxióng liánxiàn gēn nǐ bàodǎo!
ans.en: Thanks! Next time I'll report in live from Kaohsiung!

x: We take the train to the beach.
vocab.n: 台鐵 Táitiě = the regular railway; 高鐵 = the bullet train. Different systems, different stations sometimes!
Counted with 張: 兩張票. 車票 train ticket, 門票 admission ticket.

x: Where are you going for fun this weekend?
vocab.n: 好玩 hǎowán = fun (adj). 玩得開心 = have a great time.

x: I love looking at the sea.
vocab.n: 海邊 hǎibiān = seaside; 海鮮 hǎixiān = seafood — Taiwan does both exceptionally.

x: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān yíge rén lǚxíng.
vocab.n: Taiwan also says 旅遊 lǚyóu; a short trip is 小旅行.

x: 花蓮的風景美得不得了。
Huālián de fēngjǐng měi de bùdéliǎo.

vocab.n: 幫我拍一張 = take one of me — your most-used tourist sentence.
Casual; 座位 zuòwèi is the formal announcement word. 訂位 = reserve a table.

x: Wǒ yào yì zhāng láihuí piào.
vocab.n: 當天來回 = same-day round trip — the HSR lifestyle in one phrase.

x: There are more services on holidays.
vocab.n: Trains, buses, flights — any scheduled departure is a 班次; 班 alone counts them: 下一班.

x: 先看一下時刻表再買票。
Xiān kàn yíxià shíkèbiǎo zài mǎi piào.
Check the timetable before buying tickets.
In a hurry? Take free seating.
vocab.n: HSR cars 10-12. Opposite: 對號座 duìhàozuò, reserved seats. Core Taiwan life knowledge.
Business and travel both; 行程表 = the written itinerary.

x: Next week we visit the client.
vocab.n: Respectful visiting — clients, elders, officials. Friends just get 找 or 去看.

x: 出去的時候順便倒垃圾。
Chūqù de shíhòu shùnbiàn dào lèsè.
Take out the trash on your way out.
vocab.n: The politest way to add a request: 順便幫我… Note Taiwan says lèsè for 垃圾.

x: Qǐng tíqián yì tiān gàosù wǒ.
Please tell me a day ahead.
vocab.n: Interchangeable with 提早 in Taiwan; 提前 leans slightly more formal/written.
News register: 觀光產業 tourism industry, 觀光局 Tourism Administration.
The announcement word — every station broadcast opens with 各位旅客.
The noun/formal cousin of 方便 — news prose says 便利, conversation says 方便.

x: 高鐵把時間縮短了一半。
Gāotiě bǎ shíjiān suōduǎn le yíbàn.
The HSR cut travel time in half.
vocab.n: Opposite: 延長 yáncháng. A statistics-sentence workhorse.

slang.e: to veg out, do gloriously nothing
x: 這個週末我只想在家耍廢。
Zhège zhōumò wǒ zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā shuǎfèi.
This weekend I just want to rot at home gloriously.
slang.n: Taiwan youth essential — the sacred art of the do-nothing weekend. Pairs with 追劇 (binge-watching).

slang.e: to zone out, empty the mind
x: Kànzhe hǎi fàngkōng, chāo liáoyù de.
Staring at the sea, mind empty — so healing.
slang.n: Taiwan casual; 療癒 liáoyù 'healing' is its best friend. Positive vibes, not spacing out in meetings.

x: 少年時我逐工出去七逃！
Siàu-liân sî wǒ ta̍k-kang chūqù chhit-thô!
When I was young I went out to play every single day!
slang.n: Hokkien 𨑨迌, often written 七逃/佚陶. 愛七逃 = loves to roam. Grandpa-approved vocabulary.

slang.e: just up and go — a spontaneous trip
x: 來一場說走就走的旅行吧！
Lái yì chǎng shuō zǒu jiù zǒu de lǚxíng ba!
slang.n: Mainland internet catchphrase, fully adopted in Taiwan. The romantic ideal of the 自由座 lifestyle.

slang.e: to hit up the must-visit spots
x: 這次去台南要踩點三家老店。
Zhècì qù Táinán yào cǎidiǎn sān jiā lǎodiàn.
This Tainan trip I'm hitting three famous old shops.
slang.n: Mainland social-media slang, common in Taiwan travel posts; near-synonym of 打卡 for itinerary-chasing.
